subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should Usage & Spend remain a dedicated Settings pane, or should its model be integrated into the existing Overview before this feature lands?
rationale: Both placements are technically feasible and the repository guidance favors shared provider-driven UI, but only a maintainer can choose the permanent navigation and overlap boundary with the open share/export PR.

options.title: Keep Dedicated Pane
options.body: Retain the current spacious dashboard destination and keep Overview focused on its existing responsibilities after fixing the opt-out defect.

options.title: Integrate Into Overview
options.body: Reuse the dashboard model inside Overview to avoid adding a permanent sidebar destination, accepting a denser existing surface.

options.title: Pause Both Surfaces
options.body: Hold this PR and the adjacent sharing PR until a broader usage-product structure is chosen.

recommendation.title: Keep Dedicated Pane
recommendation.body: Retain the current spacious dashboard destination and keep Overview focused on its existing responsibilities after fixing the opt-out defect.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current rewrite and controls the repository's permanent Settings information architecture.
